explication: Claude Token Optimizer is a project-facing CLI for reducing and managing the documentation Claude Code loads into context. Users invoke commands through the CLI: initialize a framework-aware documentation layout, measure token usage, then audit or maintain it with compression, pruning, diffs, and live monitoring. It also manages Claude Code hook templates and refreshes project content. The excerpts show CLI dispatch and several command-to-library calls; README documents other command capabilities. Dashed edges mark README-described flows whose implementation details were not sampled.
